# Lane 2 block-grain frequencies for workload `boot-actors`.
# Generated by `cargo xtask gen-lane2-freq boot-actors` (plans/M20.md item C).
#
# Source: the **host DRAM snapshot** `wrela-vmm --dump-lane2`, which is Lane 2's
# normative sink (decision 1610). The guest transcript `lane2 hits=` line carried
# only 128 of these 372 pair(s) and said so with its own `truncated=`
# marker, so it is a bounded diagnostic and not the vector.
#
# Keys are `<fn_key>#<block_index>`, not Lane 2 ids: the `@test(runtime)` image
# this was measured on assigns 2527 block ids, while the cost-stage
# closure `wrela dump --stage=cost` scores assigns far fewer, and the two id
# spaces are disjoint. The id -> key translation happened offline here, against
# this image's own assignment map; `cost::bridge` resolves the key to a word-block
# range in the scored program's own partition and fails closed on disagreement.
#
# Most of these keys name fns the scored closure does not contain (test harness,
# boot init, unreached stdlib). Those are **uncovered** hits, charged at the
# program maximum by `cost::compose` and never dropped (04 Section 5 coverage
# honesty; freeze 1627 keeps the denominator the whole scored set).
